dataset: eICU Collaborative Research Database (illustrative — vitalPeriodic + lab tables)
description: Deliberately different shape from the MIMIC-III template: 2 sites instead of 3, 9 features instead of 17, 2 tasks instead of 4, different column names. Same model code (SiteEncoder, VFLTopModel, split_backward, DP) runs unmodified — only this file and the party registration calls change.

body.dataset_id: <uuid of the FAIRDatabase dataset backing this task>

task_creation.task_notes: task_types order is [in-hospital mortality (binary), ICU length-of-stay (regression)] — a 2-task subset, showing n_tasks/task_types is config-driven and not fixed at the MIMIC template's 4.

hashed_ids: <sha256(patientunitstayid) for each patient this site holds>

psi_submission_example.note: eICU's natural join key (patientunitstayid) differs from MIMIC-III's (subject_id) — PSI hashing is over whatever ID field the dataset uses; the plugin never assumes a specific column name.

simulation_equivalent.note: feature_groups for the in-process simulate demo, matching the 5/4 real-party split above.
